synthetic.description: Legacy 3-layer baseline (conv1/conv2/linear). Numbers are identical to the historical analytic mirror, so reference tests keep passing.

vit_base.description: ViT-Base / BERT-base encoder matching simphony/models/quantized_BERT_base.py defaults: 224px input, patch 16, dim 768, depth 12, 12 heads, MLP ratio 4.

vit_small.description: Smaller ViT encoder (dim 384, depth 6, 6 heads) for cheaper search experiments.

vit_tiny.description: Minimal ViT encoder (dim 192, depth 4, 3 heads); useful as a fast smoke workload.
